Annotation Interface Queue

@Documented @Retention(RUNTIME) @Target(METHOD) @Executable(processOnStartup=true) @MessageMapping public @interface Queue
Binds a Queue to a method for receiving or sending a Message.

Usage: 

@JMSListener("myConnectionFactory")
public class Listener {
     @Queue("my-queue")
     public <T> void handle(@MessageBody T body, @MessageHeader(JMSHeaders.JMS_MESSAGE_ID) String messageID) {
         // do some logic with body and messageID
     }

     @Queue(
         value = "my-queue-2",
         consumers = 5,
         transacted = true
     )
     public <T> void handleConcurrently(@MessageBody T body, @MessageHeader("X-Arbitrary-Header") String arbitraryHeader) {
         // do some logic with body and arbitraryHeader
     }
}

  • Element Details

    • value

      the name

    • serializer

      String serializer

    • transacted

      boolean transacted
      Whether the session is transacted. The broker must support transacted sessions.

      On a listener, message receipt is transacted: the session is committed once the method returns and rolled back if it fails. On a producer method, each message is sent on a transacted session of its own, committed after the send. That transaction is the producer's own: a producer method called from a transacted listener does not join the listener's transaction, so its message is committed even if the listener's transaction is rolled back. To send in the listener's transaction, send with the listener's Session.

      Returns:
      true if transacted
      See Also:
      • Session
      Default:
      false

    • messageSelector

      String messageSelector
      Returns:
      the message selector for the queue
      Default:
      ""

    • consumers

      int consumers
      The number of consumers of the listener method, each with its own session, so that messages are handled concurrently. The consumers share one connection. The listener bean is a single instance whose method is then called on several threads at once, so it must be thread-safe, and messages are no longer processed in the order they were sent. Ignored by producers.
      Returns:
      the number of consumers
      Since:
      5.2.0
      Default:
      1

    • deliveryMode

      JMSDeliveryMode deliveryMode
      The delivery mode of the messages that a producer method sends. Ignored by listeners. A MessageDeliveryMode argument overrides it.
      Returns:
      the delivery mode
      Since:
      5.2.0
      Default:
      PERSISTENT

    • priority

      int priority
      The priority, from 0 (lowest) to 9, of the messages that a producer method sends. Ignored by listeners. A MessagePriority argument overrides it.
      Returns:
      the priority

      4
